Microbiome alpha diversity by diet group (MetaPhlAn 4, species level).

* MetaPhlAn gives relative abundances, so pseudo-counts are built as MetaPhlAn % × 1e6
  (the smallest abundance becomes ≥ 1, so no species is lost when rounding).
* Observed richness, Shannon and Simpson are computed with `phyloseq::estimate_richness`.
* Models and plots follow `0.-Diet_group/Scripts/01.Diet_models.Rmd`:
  diet group + sex + age + BMI + log10 sequencing depth, marginal means and Tukey comparisons.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

rm(list = ls())

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(phyloseq)
library(ggpubr)
library(emmeans)
library(patchwork)
library(MASS, exclude = "select")

table_dir <- here("2.-Microbiome", "Results", "Tables")
plot_dir <- here("2.-Microbiome", "Results", "Plots")
dir.create(table_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```


# Set plot themes

```{r theme plot}
diet_colors <- c(
  "Omnivore"   = "#2864A5",
  "Vegetarian" = "#9C3F90",
  "Vegan"      = "#B36B32")
```


# Load data

```{r load data}
ps <- readRDS(here("Data", "Processed", "phyloseq_species.rds"))
ps
```


# Alpha diversity

```{r alpha}
# MetaPhlAn % x 1e6 as pseudo-counts
ps_counts <- transform_sample_counts(ps, function(x) round(x * 100 * 1e6))
n_detected <- function(p) colSums(as(otu_table(p), "matrix") > 0)
stopifnot(identical(n_detected(ps_counts), n_detected(ps)))

alpha_df <- estimate_richness(ps_counts, measures = c("Observed", "Shannon", "Simpson")) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  rename(observed = Observed, shannon = Shannon, simpson = Simpson) %>%
  left_join(as(sample_data(ps), "data.frame") %>% rownames_to_column("sample_id"), by = "sample_id") %>%
  mutate(diet_group = factor(diet_group, levels = names(diet_colors)),
         sex = factor(sex, levels = c("Female", "Male")))

summary(alpha_df %>% select(observed, shannon, simpson))
```


# Models

Covariates used in every part of the project: sex + age + BMI + log10 sequencing depth
(GPH_97 has no BMI and is dropped from the models).

```{r models}
model_shannon <- lm(shannon ~ diet_group + sex + age + bmi + log10_depth, data = alpha_df)

model_simpson <- lm(simpson ~ diet_group + sex + age + bmi + log10_depth, data = alpha_df)

model_observed <- glm(observed ~ diet_group + sex + age + bmi + log10_depth,
                      family = poisson(link = "log"),
                      data = alpha_df)
```

```{r check dispersion}
dispersion_observed <- sum(residuals(model_observed, type = "pearson")^2) / df.residual(model_observed)
cat("Dispersion of the Poisson model for observed richness:", round(dispersion_observed, 2), "\n")

# Species richness is overdispersed: use a negative binomial model instead
if (dispersion_observed > 1.5) {
  model_observed <- glm.nb(observed ~ diet_group + sex + age + bmi + log10_depth, data = alpha_df)
  cat("Negative binomial model used for observed richness\n")
}
```


# Marginal means estimation and comparison

```{r estimated marginal means}
get_estimates <- function(model, type = "link") {
  emmeans(model, ~ diet_group, type = type) %>%
    confint(level = 0.95) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rename_with(~ "estimate", any_of(c("emmean", "response", "rate"))) %>%
    rename_with(~ "conf_low", any_of(c("lower.CL", "asymp.LCL"))) %>%
    rename_with(~ "conf_high", any_of(c("upper.CL", "asymp.UCL"))) %>%
    select(diet_group, estimate, conf_low, conf_high)
}

get_comparisons <- function(model, type = "link") {
  emmeans(model, pairwise ~ diet_group, type = type, adjust = "tukey")$contrasts %>%
    test() %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    separate(contrast, into = c("group1", "group2"), sep = " - | / ") %>%
    mutate(p.adj = p.value,
           p.signif = case_when(p.adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
                                p.adj < 0.01 ~ "**",
                                p.adj < 0.05 ~ "*",
                                TRUE ~ "ns"))
}

estimate_shannon <- get_estimates(model_shannon)
estimate_simpson <- get_estimates(model_simpson)
estimate_observed <- get_estimates(model_observed, type = "response")

comparison_shannon <- get_comparisons(model_shannon)
comparison_simpson <- get_comparisons(model_simpson)
comparison_observed <- get_comparisons(model_observed, type = "response")
```

```{r estimation results}
cat("\nMean estimation for observed richness:\n"); print(estimate_observed)
cat("\nMean estimation for Shannon:\n"); print(estimate_shannon)
cat("\nMean estimation for Simpson:\n"); print(estimate_simpson)

cat("\nMean comparison for observed richness:\n"); print(comparison_observed)
cat("\nMean comparison for Shannon:\n"); print(comparison_shannon)
cat("\nMean comparison for Simpson:\n"); print(comparison_simpson)
cat("\n p-values adjusted by tukey\n")
```


# Plot means

```{r plot function}
set_relative_pvalue_positions <- function(comparison_df,
                                          estimate_df,
                                          lower_padding = 0.50,
                                          bracket_start = 0.12,
                                          bracket_step = 0.10,
                                          upper_padding = 0.08) {
  data_min <- min(estimate_df$conf_low, na.rm = TRUE)
  data_max <- max(estimate_df$conf_high, na.rm = TRUE)
  data_range <- data_max - data_min

  if (!is.finite(data_range) || data_range == 0) {
    data_range <- abs(data_max) * 0.1
    if (data_range == 0) {
      data_range <- 1}}

  comparison_df <- comparison_df %>%
    mutate(y.position = data_max +
             data_range * bracket_start +
             data_range * bracket_step * (row_number() - 1))

  y_lower <- data_min - data_range * lower_padding
  y_upper <- max(comparison_df$y.position, na.rm = TRUE) + data_range * upper_padding

  list(comparison = comparison_df,
       limits = c(y_lower, y_upper))}

plot_means <- function(estimate_df, comparison_df, title, y_label) {
  positions <- set_relative_pvalue_positions(comparison_df, estimate_df)

  ggplot(estimate_df, aes(x = diet_group, y = estimate, colour = diet_group)) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf_low, ymax = conf_high),
                  width = 0.12,
                  linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = diet_colors, guide = "none") +
    stat_pvalue_manual(positions$comparison,
                       xmin = "group1",
                       xmax = "group2",
                       y.position = "y.position",
                       label = "p.signif",
                       bracket.size = 0.8,
                       tip.length = 0.01,
                       size = 4) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = positions$limits, clip = "off") +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = y_label) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
          axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", colour = unname(diet_colors), size = 9),
          axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
          axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
          axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 8, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5))
}
```

```{r final plot, warning=FALSE}
plot_alpha <- (
  plot_means(estimate_observed, comparison_observed, "Species richness", "Observed species") |
  plot_means(estimate_shannon, comparison_shannon, "Shannon diversity", "Shannon index") |
  plot_means(estimate_simpson, comparison_simpson, "Simpson diversity", "Simpson index")
) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1, 1))

plot_alpha
```


# Save

```{r save}
write_tsv(alpha_df %>% select(sample_id, observed, shannon, simpson),
          file.path(table_dir, "microbiome_alpha.tsv"))

write_tsv(bind_rows(Observed = comparison_observed, Shannon = comparison_shannon,
                    Simpson = comparison_simpson, .id = "index"),
          file.path(table_dir, "alpha_diet_comparisons.tsv"))

# Family and dispersion of each alpha-diversity model, so the Methods can name the model actually fitted
write_tsv(tibble(index = c("Observed", "Shannon", "Simpson"),
                 family = c(if (inherits(model_observed, "negbin")) "negative binomial" else "poisson",
                            "gaussian", "gaussian"),
                 poisson_dispersion = c(dispersion_observed, NA, NA),
                 nb_theta = c(if (inherits(model_observed, "negbin")) model_observed$theta else NA, NA, NA),
                 n = c(nobs(model_observed), nobs(model_shannon), nobs(model_simpson))),
          file.path(table_dir, "alpha_model_diagnostics.tsv"))

ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "Alpha_diversity_by_diet.png"), plot_alpha, height = 5, width = 10, dpi = 600)
```
